notes.title: Nova Jumper is out now for Windows PCs!
notes.content: [h1]Nova Jumper is now out for Windows![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601184/97942341fb5fa30c43434ec0abfcf43182743e1b.png"][/img][/p][h2]Hi everyone,[/h2][p]Thanks for your support in wishlisting Nova Jumper. The game is now available for Windows PCs![/p][p]I hope you enjoy playing this game as much as I enjoyed making it.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45601184/e148a04117fa216bab50da4f0d290e32706be173.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Steamworks Integration[/h1][h2]You can now join friends using Steam![/h2][p]Once you enter a level, a lobby will open that will be open for any of your friends to join. You can also[/p][p]invite friends through Steam overlay (Shift + Tab, if you didn't already know...)[/p][p][/p][h1]VR Support[/h1][h2]VR has been tested to work with the Oculus CV1![/h2][p][/p][p]Okay, that's all I've got to say for now. Thanks again for wishlisting and I hope you enjoy the game![/p][p](Please leave a good review if you do)[/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely,[/p][p]Paul[/p]
